value.rationale: This gives a unique complete, closed-form, feasible-law classification for a nonadaptive two-sensor Gaussian bridge integration design with correlated loss; the two critical physical quantities marginal reliability and co-delivery rate separate cleanly. Correlation of failures strictly degrades the optimized risk even while the required spatial separation increases. These natural boundaries, the endpoint designs and the derivative frontier provide a useful exact placement rule, not a mere numerical table or an arbitrary narrow parameter slice. No application to noisy, adaptive or many-sensor design is inferred.
